name: Scarf Snowman
text: Have you decorated your tree nicely? It's an interesting experience, to say the least, decorating a Christmas tree with other people. Don't cha think?  Oh yeah ... are you suuuuure you want to leave this place?

name: Scarf Snowman
text: You need more time decorating trees, huh? If you ever feel like leaving this place, feel free to come talk to me~
